additional_info.subject: RE: 0475261 - ID0475261-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/T3314161484001] Charging Issue CRM:03208000158
additional_info.body:
HI,
18.03:
KF11 was replaced with a new unit.
27.03:
KF14 was replaced with the KF14 from the right‑hand charger, where the issue was not present.
QA21–22:
Already replaced at the end of 2025.
Voltage measurements between
TF1 and TF5
were checked completely; however, the system works without issues only for a certain period after a restart.
Using the debugging tool, the voltage was also checked and showed no abnormalities.
As you can see, we have already been on site multiple times, but without success.
Please forward this to the experts, as we now urgently need a solution.
Kind regards,
Johannes
